summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a 1-for-25 reverse stock split approved by stockholders and the board, effective July 7, 2026. Outstanding shares will reduce from ~13.2M to ~530k, with authorized shares unchanged at 601M. No price per share, premium, or consideration is involved. The split is a routine capital structure adjustment to maintain Nasdaq compliance, not a special situation. No deal terms or advisor involvement are mentioned. The filing is a technical amendment with no event-driven catalyst for shareholders.
